title: Uniform measure of a singleton in a finite type
statement: Let $k \ge 1$, and equip the finite set $\mathrm{Fin}\,k = \{0, 1, \dots, k-1\}$ with its uniform probability measure. Then for every element $a \in \mathrm{Fin}\,k$, the real-valued measure of the singleton $\{a\}$ equals $1/k$.
replaced:
For $k \ge 1$ and any $a : \mathrm{Fin}\,k$, the real-valued uniform measure of $\{a\}$
in $\mathrm{Fin}\,k$ equals $1/k \in \mathbb{R}$, i.e.\ $\mu_{\mathbb{R}}(\{a\}) = 1/k$.
